rollback_or_rollforward: Reversible: downgrade drops the tenant-isolation RLS policies (and disables FORCE/RLS) on the northstar_annotation tenant tables, then drops the annotation_moderation and annotation tables and the northstar_annotation schema (CASCADE); on a shared environment restore from the pre-migration backup instead. Annotations retain their original revision target and are never mutated in place by this migration.

prechecks: database is a supported PostgreSQL version
postchecks: northstar_annotation schema with annotation and annotation_moderation tables exists
row-level security is enabled and forced on every tenant-scoped annotation table with a tenant-isolation policy keyed to the northstar.tenant_id GUC

compatibility_window: Phase 3 annotations, comments and notes baseline
